auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to recurring operating losses, accumulated losses exceeding net worth, and pending writ petition for property redemption. Emphasis on default in redemption of preference shares (Rs 551.89 lakhs) and unpaid preference dividend (Rs 485.27 lakhs). Emphasis on ongoing legal proceedings regarding balance auction proceeds of Rs 8,500 lakhs from Hotel Park Hyatt Goa sale, with Recovery Officer order directing payment of Rs 26,604.27 lakhs to PACL Limited, currently challenged before SAT.
